title: IVG Pro Salts Cola BG 10ml E-Liquid
description: IVG Pro Nic Salts Cola GB 10ml E-Liquid offers a unique and playful take on beloved sweet shop classics. The profile begins with the distinct, slightly spiced and syrupy taste of traditional Cola. This beverage-inspired base is then seamlessly blended with the sugary, chewy notes of classic Bubblegum. The combination delivers a smooth, highly nostalgic finish that faithfully recreates the satisfying taste of popular fizzy cola candies. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid delivery and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation to effectively manage nicotine intake. The balanced 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal combination of clear, intense flavour and discreet vapour production. IVG Pro Salts are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits, serving as a highly cost-effective alternative to single-use or prefilled systems. The IVG Pro Salts collection takes the globally revered flavour profiles from the beloved IVG Pro prefilled pod range and makes them available in convenient 10ml bottles. As a multi-award-winning UK brand, IVG ensures exceptional quality across a massive selection of e-liquids. Beyond the sweet nostalgia of Cola GB, vapers can explore other standout blends such as the vibrant Hub Blast or the sharp citrus of Lemon Fizz, ensuring a premium option for every palate.
